name: callwarden-alm
description: A governed ALM delivery team for Call Warden: requirement breakdown, call-graph-driven review, acceptance evidence, and daemon-backed task governance.

displayName.zh: Call Warden ALM 治理交付团

profession.zh: Call Warden ALM 治理交付团

displayDescription.en: Turns requirement clarification, call-graph-driven review, acceptance evidence and daemon task governance into one auditable delivery chain with four mutually-checking roles.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖需求拆解、调用图选靶审查、验收取证与任务治理，四角色互相制衡，全程可追溯可审计。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要给 callwarden 加一个新功能：先做需求澄清和任务拆解，再实现、独立评审、验收取证，最后按 daemon 治理关单。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to add a new feature to callwarden: clarify and break down the requirement, then implement, independently review, capture acceptance evidence, and close it under daemon governance.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要给 callwarden 加一个新功能：先做需求澄清和任务拆解，再实现、独立评审、验收取证，最后按 daemon 治理关单。
quickPrompts.en: I want to add a new feature to callwarden: clarify and break down the requirement, then implement, independently review, capture acceptance evidence, and close it under daemon governance.

quickPrompts.zh: 审查 callwarden 最近的改动：用调用图选靶，输出分级报告，并把要动作的发现建成任务单。
quickPrompts.en: Review the recent callwarden changes: pick targets from the call graph, output a graded report, and file every actionable finding as a task.

quickPrompts.zh: 对某个 AC 跑验收：选最小充分测试集，按六条件判定，补齐八段证据。
quickPrompts.en: Run acceptance for one AC: choose the minimal sufficient test set, judge by the six conditions, and complete the eight-section evidence.
